subject.title: [Bug]: The project won't start on Windows and WSL.

question: Should OpenClaw require a focused current-main Windows/WSL second-build repro before choosing between a tsdown update/pin/wrapper fix and a broader tsdown-to-tsc rollback?
rationale: The issue has credible hang evidence on a supported setup surface, but the proposed rollback is a broad build-system direction that automation should not choose without maintainer intent and dependency proof.

options.title: Require focused repro first
options.body: Run or request current-main native Windows and WSL first-build/second-build logs, then choose the smallest fix from the isolated failure path.

options.title: Treat as beta-blocking now
options.body: Promote this to maintainer-owned beta-blocking build-tool work and let owners choose a rollback or dependency change before full reproduction is captured.

options.title: Defer until reporter logs
options.body: Keep the issue open but wait for full reporter logs because the screenshot alone does not prove the root cause.

recommendation.title: Require focused repro first
recommendation.body: Run or request current-main native Windows and WSL first-build/second-build logs, then choose the smallest fix from the isolated failure path.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest concrete history for Windows tsdown wrapper behavior points to vincentkoc's recent process-tree, taskkill, and runner work.
